answer: Yes. If you sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, we'll request the dealer payoff quote from Summit Auto Lease for you, so you don't have to call them. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts. If our offer comes in higher than the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference to you as lease equity. Bring the dealer payoff quote to your appraisal appointment. Note that NW-LPA-1 is the form for loans, not leases. The help center doesn't say how long a lease payoff request takes, so please check with a store about timing.
